svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut the plate 38 x 30 x 5 mm from flat bar. Drill two 6.6 mm holes 22 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: apart on its centre line, for M6 rivnuts in the column wall.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut the cup from 32 mm OD x 24 mm ID steel tube, 70 mm long; cut a

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 3 mm disc 32 mm across for its base and weld it all round.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Stand the cup on its base against the plate's outer face, flush with the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: plate's lower edge, and weld it along both sides of the contact line.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: two M6 rivnuts in the column's right wall (see the column sketch),

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: two M6 screws through the plate. The cup then leans out 61 mm from the wall.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the plunger stands tip down in the cup, 67 mm deep, and cannot be

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: knocked over by a push of the hand; the cup is clear of the shelf.
